de: Besuchen Sie den Monkey Forest, um Berberaffen in einem freien Gehege zu sehen.
Planen Sie einen ganzen Tag für das Trentham Estate ein, um die Gärten und den See zu erkunden.
Kaufen Sie Tickets für die Gärten online im Voraus, um Warteschlangen zu vermeiden.
Parken Sie auf dem großen, kostenlosen Parkplatz des Shopping Village.
Besuchen Sie die Gegend unter der Woche, um den großen Menschenmengen am Wochenende zu entgehen.
hu: Látogass el a Majomerdőbe (Monkey Forest), ahol szabadon sétáló berber makákókat láthatsz.
Tervezz egy egész napot a Trentham Estate-re a kertek és a tó felfedezéséhez.
Vedd meg a jegyet a kertekbe online előre, hogy elkerüld a sorban állást.
Használd a Shopping Village hatalmas, ingyenes parkolóját.
Látogass el ide hétköznap, hogy elkerüld a hétvégi nagy tömeget.
ro: Vizitați Monkey Forest pentru a vedea maimuțe macac berber într-un mediu deschis.
Rezervați o zi întreagă pentru Trentham Estate, pentru a explora grădinile și lacul.
Cumpărați biletele pentru grădini online în avans pentru a evita cozile.
Parcați în parcarea mare și gratuită a satului comercial (Shopping Village).
Vizitați zona în timpul săptămânii pentru a evita aglomerația din weekend.
en: Visit the Trentham Monkey Forest to see Barbary macaques roaming free in the woodland.
Allow a full day for the Trentham Estate to see the Italian Gardens and walk around the lake.
Book your garden tickets online in advance to guarantee entry and potentially save time.
Parking at the Shopping Village is extensive and free for visitors.
Visit during a weekday if possible, as the estate and shops get very busy on sunny weekends.

hu.name: Staffordshire Oatcakes

hu.name: Shopping Village teázói

ro.name: Staffordshire Oatcakes

en.name: Staffordshire Oatcakes

en.name: Afternoon Tea in the Village
en.tip: Enjoy a refined tea service in one of the boutique cafes within the timber lodge shopping area.

de.name: Trentham Shopping Village
de.tip: Ein einzigartiges Einkaufszentrum aus Blockhütten mit vielen unabhängigen Boutiquen.

de.name: Gartencenter
de.tip: Ein riesiges Areal für Pflanzenliebhaber mit einer großen Auswahl an Gartenprodukten.

hu.name: Trentham Shopping Village
hu.tip: Egyedülálló, rönkházakból álló bevásárlófalu sok független butikkal.

hu.name: Kertészeti központ
hu.tip: Hatalmas terület a növénybarátoknak, széles kerti választékkal.

ro.name: Trentham Shopping Village

ro.name: Centrul de grădinărit
ro.tip: O zonă vastă pentru iubitorii de plante, cu o selecție largă de produse pentru grădină.

en.name: Trentham Shopping Village
en.tip: A charming shopping area composed of timber lodges featuring independent boutiques and galleries.

en.name: The Garden Centre
en.tip: One of the largest in the region, offering a vast selection of plants and lifestyle products.

de.name: Trentham Lake Walk
de.tip: Ein ca. 3 km langer, ebener Spaziergang rund um den See, umgeben von Natur.

de.name: Italienische Gärten
de.tip: Wunderschön angelegte Gärten, die besonders früh am Morgen sehr friedlich sind.

hu.tip: Körülbelül 3 km-es, sík sétaút a tó körül, természettel körülvéve.

hu.name: Olasz kertek

ro.name: Plimbarea pe malul lacului Trentham
ro.tip: Un traseu plat de aproximativ 3 km în jurul lacului, înconjurat de natură.

ro.name: Grădinile Italiene
ro.tip: Grădini superb amenajate, care sunt foarte liniștite mai ales dimineața devreme.

en.name: Trentham Lake Walk
en.tip: A level 2-mile circular lakeside walk offering serene views and plenty of wildlife.

en.name: Italian Gardens
en.tip: Formal gardens that offer a peaceful atmosphere, especially during quiet morning hours.
